neighbours.label: a first-person speaker positioning themself before giving a view: the comma in 'I, for one,' / 'as' in 'for me, as a parent,'
fire: Some readers loved the ending, but I, for my part, found it rushed.
From where I stand as a nurse, the new rota is unworkable.
Others may disagree; I, however, think the bridge should stay.
To me, as a lifelong cyclist, the new lanes are a gift.
Speaking from experience as a coach, I would rest him this week.
Many people complained, and I, too, was annoyed by the delay.
In my view as an economist, the tax will do little harm.
Most of the class left early, but I, naturally, stayed to the end.
quiet: Some readers loved the ending, but the critics found it rushed.
From where the nurses stand, the new rota is unworkable.
Others may disagree; the council, however, wants the bridge to stay.
To most cyclists in the city, the new lanes are a gift.
Experienced coaches would rest the player this week.
Many people complained, and the manager was annoyed by the delay.
In the view of most economists, the tax will do little harm.
Most of the class left early, but a few students stayed to the end.

notes: probe: 'I, for one,' 0.76; 'For me, as a parent,' 0.91; plain 'for one reason' 0.10
